EC1: Active [OR] or past psychotic disorder, including a history of psychotic affective state
EC2: Mental Retardation [OR] or Autistic Spectrum Disorder
EC4: Cardiac [OR] or neurologic active medical condition, including past CVA [OR]/TIA (Cardiovascular Accident [OR]/Transient Ischemic Attack) [OR] or any other unstable medical condition.
EC6: Active [OR] or recent drug [OR] or alcohol abuse
EC7: Substantial suicidality [AND] in a patient requiring admission but refuses to do so, and signs an "against medical advice" release form as part of clinical evaluation, and does not answer the terms for involuntary admission.
